questions.label: Which city is closest to your home?
Is your household low or moderate income by Efficiency Vermont's guidelines?
questions.help: The 2026 income limits took effect July 1, 2026. Check them on efficiencyvermont.com.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: ductless heat pump
programs.rules: Qualifying cold-climate equipment for Vermont electric customers. Distributor discounts start at $375.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: ducted heat pump
programs.rules: Qualifying cold-climate equipment for Vermont electric customers. Distributor discounts start at $1,200.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: integrated controls bonus
programs.rules: An extra $600 for integrated controls with a ductless heat pump.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: income bonus for heat pumps
programs.rules: The amount depends on your utility and income level. Confirm yours with Efficiency Vermont, so it is not added to your total.

programs.name: Green Mountain Power income-eligible heat pump rebate
programs.rules: For customers at or below 80% of area median income, paid with the Efficiency Vermont rebate. We have not re-confirmed it is still open, so it is not in your total.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: heat pump water heater
programs.rules: $600 discount, plus $400 more for low- and moderate-income households.

programs.name: Efficiency Vermont: weatherization
programs.rules: 75% of the project cost back, up to $4,000. Moderate-income households get up to $9,500. You need an Efficiency Excellence Network contractor.

notes: Burlington is served by Burlington Electric Department, and Barre, Montpelier, Rutland and South Burlington by Green Mountain Power. Burlington Electric offers its own extras that we have not verified.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment and your final invoice.
